name: Amano Miaka
source: One day, a mysterious girl with silver hair suddenly appeared in front of the protagonist. The tone and gestures are childish, and she laughs a lot. She has a floating atmosphere, and the content of her speech is self-contained. If you understand yourself, you will speak to the other person without explanation, so you will feel that you are somewhat off.
